'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Diehl LS Hoth''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Diehl]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' ANSBLEH
* '''Username:''' scottd
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
